messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "bleeding or blood-clotting disorder"
set: ["bleeding or blood-clotting disorder", "may cause bleeding in mother or unborn baby", "may cause jaundice or bleeding problems in a newborn", "may cause easy bruising or bleeding when used with NSAID", "more likely in people with bipolar disorder", "may increase risk of heavy bleeding after delivery", "may increase risk of severe bleeding after childbirth", "could increase risk of excessive bleeding after birth", "taking these products together can increase risk of bleeding", "risk of triggering manic episode in bipolar disorder patients", "risk is especially high if you have a history of depression, mental illness, or bipolar disorder", "can cause bleeding in mother if taken within 1 week before childbirth", "new or worse depression or anxiety", "pancreas or gallbladder problems", "dizziness or drowsiness can cause falls, accidents, or severe injuries", "suicidal behaviour or ideation"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "may cause bleeding in mother or unborn baby",
    "may cause easy bruising or bleeding when used with NSAID",
    "may increase risk of heavy bleeding after delivery",
    "may increase risk of severe bleeding after childbirth",
    "could increase risk of excessive bleeding after birth",
    "taking these products together can increase risk of bleeding",
    "can cause bleeding in mother if taken within 1 week before childbirth"
  ],
  "alias": "may cause bleeding in mother or unborn baby"
}
